title: Running Commentary on Torah 55 — Abba Shaul Kover Meisim
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 55 — אבא שאול קובר מתים
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Three-layer line-by-line gloss: beginner = readable English prose with bracketed translations; intermediate = compact bilingual summary with citations; scholarly = terse Hebrew citation list. Coarse 17-segment structure preserves Rabbeinu's own ois-marking (א–ט). Torah 55 unfolds the Nidah-24b mishnah of Abba Shaul ('I was a burier of the dead, once I chased a deer and entered the kulis of a corpse') as a coded drasha on: (i) the downfall of resha'im via kedushas Eretz Yisrael, (ii) the three kolos of fools/philosophers/mockers that must be rectified in tefilah, (iii) the parah adumah's erez+eizov+shni-tola'as as the three kolos, (iv) tefilah b'tzibbur as tzibur=tzadikim+beinonim+resha'im (afar va'eifer), and (v) the closing teaching that even Moshe feared Og because Og's grasp was near yamin=EY. Written in Rabbeinu's own leshon (per the inclusio at segs 1 + 17).

segments.beginner: The revach of olam ha-zeh cannot be measured: how much a person can profit in this world without having to spend from his own resources — what they call in Yiddish 'oys-lag' (no out-of-pocket cost). Only from what the Borei yisborach has prepared in front of him, he can extend his hand and gain very much. 'Ayin lo ra'asah'.
segments.intermediate: **Revach ha-olam ha-zeh ein le-sha'er** — dehaynu **mah she-ha-adam yachol le-har-vi'ach ba-olam ha-zeh ve-ein tzarich al-zeh hotza'os mi-shelo**, she-korin **'אויש לאג'** (oys-lag), **rak mi-mah she-heichin lefanav ha-Borei yisborach yachol le-harchiv yado u-le-har-vi'ach harbeh me'od.** "עַיִן לֹא רָאָתָה..." (יש' סד:ג).
segments.scholarly: [T2:55] ריוח העוה"ז ללא הוצאות ("אויש לאג"). "עין לא ראתה" (יש' סד:ג; ברכות לד:). הקב"ה מכין לפני האדם, רק יש להרחיב יד.
